about:
About this property

Century Attur is an pre-launch residential project by Century Group, located on Attur Main Road in Yelahanka, Bangalore. Spread over 15 acres, the project will feature 14 towers thoughtfully designed with 2, 2.5, and 3 BHK apartments. The homes will range from 1160 - 1760 sq.ft, offering spacious living spaces for families of all sizes. With a total of 1200 Units and 18 floors, Century Attur promises modern living in a well-planned community. The project is set in a prime location with excellent connectivity to schools, hospitals, shopping centres, and major roads, making it an ideal choice for both homebuyers and investors. Century Attur is a pre-launch project, giving early buyers the opportunity to select their preferred apartment and enjoy flexible payment options. The project will be registered under RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Authority), ensuring transparency and reliability for all buyers. The possession of the apartments is expected by December 2029, giving ample time for planning and investment. RERA registration also means that all project details, approvals, and legal documents are verified, providing peace of mind to buyers.
